product.name: Tinto Digital · Wallet loyalty + WhatsApp assistant
product.intake: Tinto Digital builds custom software and marketing for independent Latin American restaurants in the Bay Area. Core offer: a loyalty card that lives in Apple and Google Wallet (QR sign-up, no app), a WhatsApp assistant that answers customers and captures consented contacts, and a funnel with weekly KPIs. Piloted with one arepa restaurant in San José. Software is custom software owned by Tinto and licensed to the client. Third-party costs such as ads are paid by the client.

product.name: Force Energy · Solar + Storage (EPC turnkey)
product.intake: Force Energy designs, installs and legalizes on-grid solar, off-grid and battery (BESS) systems in Santander, Colombia. 41 projects delivered, 528 kWp across 9 municipalities, including three off-grid Indigenous schools. Typical size 10 to 30 kVA, largest 70 kVA. Includes grid-operator filing, RETIE compliance, monitoring and O&M. Pre-sale quote in minutes through the FE Platform pre-quoter. Price reference about COP 3.6M per kWp, always preliminary until a site visit.

fields.label: Target industries
fields.why: Highest load factor and daytime consumption; Santander produces about 25% of national chicken and 23% of eggs with roughly 1,186 farms (Solar Fox).

fields.label: Company size
fields.value: 20 to 500 employees; electricity bill above about COP 8M per month; usable roof or land above 150 m²
fields.why: Typical project 10 to 30 kVA fits this band; the 70 kVA record sets the upper edge.

fields.label: Buyer personas
fields.why: EPC buyers sign after a technical and a financial review.

fields.label: Trigger events
value: Energy audit or thesis published about the site
fields.why: Each trigger is observable in public sources and ties to a buying window.

fields.why: Force Energy operates here; the grid operator filing is local.
